description:
Jingburger was having a rough time in life with finding a part time job and achieving her dream to become an idol. Since nothing was going as she was expecting, she was feeling very pessimistic about her future... until she met a magical poop head dog that suddenly told her that she had been forced to sign a "Magical Girls Contract" and took her to the "Magical World."

Now she has to defeat monsters in order to survive, but that's not all; the dog also tells her that if she succeeds in doing her duties of purifying monsters, she will be granted one wish. However, she is not the only magical girl desperate enough to have her wish granted, and there is another way to get your wish granted: by taking the soul of other magical girls!!

"How do you expect me to fight terrifying monsters like that?!"
"Why the hell is my weapon a hamburger?!!"
"What am I going to do if other magical girls try to hunt me?!!!!"

Six magical girls are in for a thrilling action-packed adventure!

(Source: Kakao, translated)

*Note: Based on the VTuber group Isegye Idol.*
